title: Carbs from Calculator are not recorded
body:
On Nov 10 at 2116, bolus was calculated for 65g carbs using the Calculator on AAPS. After hitting "OK" on the Calculator screen, bolus was delivered in its totality. However, the 65g carbs were never recorded in the Treatments page, nor did they show up as COB on the Overview page.

AAPS 3.3.2.1, Build: 937e2bccc9-2025.10.21

Log file:

[AndroidAPS._2025-11-10_21-35-05_.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23474219/AndroidAPS._2025-11-10_21-35-05_.log)
